_readme: Keys are the Russian source strings. A locale file maps each key to its translation.

strings.note: Header toggle button (lowercase, very short, ≤ 12 chars). Shows/hides system apps like WirePlumber, portals.

strings.key:
Показать служебные приложения (WirePlumber, порталы и т.п.).
Они появятся ниже разделительной полосы.
strings.note: Tooltip of that button. Two lines separated by \n; keep the \n. Keep 'WirePlumber' untranslated.
Section header above the list of system apps. Shown in UPPERCASE by the UI, so give a short noun/adjective (1-2 words).
Section header above the list of apps. Shown UPPERCASE. 'Application audio' (1-3 words).
Window subtitle (lowercase): 'volume of each application separately'.
Subtitle when nothing is listed: 'no sound sources'. Lowercase.
Counter in the subtitle: 'applications: N'. Keep %d. Lowercase, no plural forms needed (use the 'label: number' pattern).
Second subtitle part: 'sources: N' (e.g. mpv playing inside Anki). Keep the leading ' · ' (space, middle dot, space) and %d.
Third subtitle part: 'playing: N' (how many apps are producing sound now). Keep the leading ' · ' and %d.
Title of the master volume card for the current audio output device: 'Master volume'.
Tooltip/accessible label of the master mute button: 'Mute the whole system'.
Tooltip of a mute button when muted: 'Unmute'.
Tooltip of a mute button: 'Mute'.
Accessible label of a volume slider: 'Volume: <app name>'. Keep %s.
Accessible label: 'Mute: <app name>'. Keep %s.
Accessible label: 'Unmute: <app name>'. Keep %s.
Tooltip: 'audio server key: <name>' (PipeWire/PulseAudio application name). Keep %s.

strings.key: приложение сейчас молчит — громкость применится, когда зазвучит
strings.note: Tooltip sentence: 'the app is silent now — the volume will apply when it starts playing'. Keep the em dash style natural for the language.
Tooltip of the green dot: 'playing now'.
Row subtitle state: 'silent' (the app is not playing sound). Lowercase, 1 word.
Row subtitle state used when audio plays but no track/tab title is known: 'playing'. Lowercase, 1 word.
Row subtitle state when the app is muted: 'muted' / 'turned off'. Lowercase, 1 word.
Tooltip of the light/dark theme switch: 'Theme: dark / light'.
Accessible label of the theme switch: 'Dark theme'.
Header button label (lowercase, very short, ≤ 10 chars): 'language'.
Tooltip of the language button and title of its menu: 'Interface language'.
Menu item: follow the system language ('System default'). Short.
Title of a desktop notification: 'Audio output'. 1-2 words.
Title of the output-device menu and tooltip of the device button: 'Output device'.
Tooltip of a small eye button on an audio output in a list: 'Hide this output' (removes dead outputs from the list and from hotkey switching).
Tooltip of a small button that restores a hidden audio output: 'Show this output again'.
Label of a collapsible group in the menu: 'Hidden: N'. Keep %d.
Button text: 'Hide unavailable (N)' — hides all outputs that have no connected device. Keep %d.
Small badge next to an audio output whose device is not connected: 'unavailable'. Lowercase, 1 word.
Button text: 'Switch to next output' (audio output device). Short.
Label: 'Hotkey' (keyboard shortcut for switching the output). Short.
Value shown when no hotkey is set: 'not set'. Lowercase.
Prompt shown while recording a keyboard shortcut: 'press a key combination… (Esc — cancel)'. Keep the ellipsis.
Notification body when there is nothing to switch to: 'No other available outputs'.
Tooltip of a button that clears the hotkey: 'Clear' / 'Reset'. 1 word.

strings.key: Переключение работает только пока программа запущена. Рекомендуем добавить её в автозапуск.
strings.note: One short note shown under the hotkey setting: 'Switching works only while the program is running. We recommend adding it to autostart.' Two short sentences; natural phrase for 'autostart' (startup applications).
Window title and header button tooltip: 'Appearance' settings.
Settings group header: 'Look' (layout).
Settings group header: 'Colors'.
Setting: 'Design type'.
